I design geospatial workflows, dashboards, analysis notebooks, and field-to-decision systems for mosquito surveillance, treatment planning, UAS operations, and integrated public health mosquito control.

## What this portfolio demonstrates

::: {.grid .focus-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Applied geospatial analysis

GIS, spatial data science, and reproducible analysis applied to real mosquito control and public health operations.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Operational decision support

Dashboards, notebooks, field apps, and data pipelines that connect surveillance data to treatment planning and program evaluation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### UAS and remote sensing workflows

Drone, photogrammetry, LiDAR, and habitat-mapping approaches for inspection, targeting, and operational assessment.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Public health communication

Maps, plain-language summaries, and visual tools that make technical information usable for managers, field staff, and public health partners.
:::

:::

## Current focus

I am especially interested in geospatial decision-support systems that connect field surveillance, environmental conditions, remote sensing, and treatment operations into workflows that are reproducible, explainable, and useful for integrated pest management.
